rows.proof: THE TOWN'S FORWARD DEBT SERVICE, FY2019 TO FY2047, pages 49 and 51 of the FY2018 annual town report -- 29 fiscal years against eleven printed measures: the Meadow Woods SEWER and WATER general obligation issues (principal, interest, total each) and five GRAND TOTAL rows over all of the town's debt (principal, interest, principal & interest, MWPAT admin fees, TOTAL DEBT). The two pages are ONE table: p49 carries FY2019-FY2035 and p51 carries FY2036-FY2047 and the printed TOTAL column. BOTH PAGES ARE PRINTED SIDEWAYS. THE TWO PAGES WERE READ BY DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS BECAUSE THEY ARE DIFFERENT KINDS OF PAGE: p49 carries its OWN TEXT LAYER (pdfplumber, 458 words, every word direction `ttb`), so its characters are exact; p51 is a PHOTOGRAPH (one image, 2436x620, 287 dpi) and was rendered with render_pdf_page.swift and read by eye, then re-read from a 2x crop. No recognition was used on either. On p49 two cells arrive with a header word printed THROUGH the figure -- the text layer holds `OBLIGATIO$N82,060` and `OBLIGATIO$N58,468` as single tokens -- so the letters are partitioned out before the money is parsed, which is the FY2014 defect and the same remedy; both recovered cells are confirmed by their own row identity (25,000+57,060=82,060 and 20,000+38,468=58,468). WHAT PROVES IT: 319 figures, 116 row identities and 11 column totals. Of the 116 row identities (29 years x 4: sewer principal+interest=sewer total, water the same, grand total principal+interest=principal & interest, and that plus MWPAT admin fees=TOTAL DEBT), 106 close EXACTLY and 10 are out by exactly $1.00; none by more. Summed down the 29 years against the TOTAL column the page itself prints, GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL & INTEREST ties EXACTLY at $70,295,422 and GRAND TOTAL INTEREST ties EXACTLY at $20,633,100, as do both bond principal columns, $1,515,000 and $1,020,000; the worst residual on any column is $8 (Meadow Woods water interest). A TOLERANCE OF $8.00 IS DECLARED, and the reason is the one the schedule states by its own shape: IT PRINTS WHOLE DOLLARS OVER AMOUNTS THAT CARRY CENTS, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts -- 29 displayed values bound the difference at $14.50, and the columns with NO cents beneath them (the two bond principal columns) tie exactly, which is the contrast that says rounding rather than a misread. The tolerance was NOT widened to make anything pass: the exact $70,295,422 and $20,633,100 ties over 29 values each are what carry the read, and no single wrong digit anywhere in either column could survive them. WHAT THIS DOES NOT HOLD: the PER-ISSUE detail. Page 48 of the same report prints the individual bond issues behind these GRAND TOTAL rows and is a 110 dpi photograph; it is not read here, so the archive can say what the town owes in total in each year to 2047 and cannot say which issue retires when. Only the two Meadow Woods issues are broken out, because the page itself breaks them out.

rows.proof: TOWN OF LUNENBURG DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE AS OF JUNE 30, 2018, PER ISSUE -- pages 48 and 50 of the FY2018 annual town report, with the two MEADOW WOODS issues the same schedule prints on pages 49 and 51. SIXTEEN DEBT ISSUES against fiscal years 2019 to 2047 and 229 issue-years, each in up to four rows: PRINCIPAL, INTEREST, ADMIN FEE and the issue's own TOTAL. Six of the sixteen print no ADMIN FEE row at all; that is recorded as absent, not as zero. PAGE 50 WAS NOT IN THE PAGE TRACKER AT ALL, and it is the half of this table that makes it checkable: it carries FY2036 to FY2047 and, at its right-hand edge, a printed TOTAL for EVERY ISSUE. A page enters the tracker on fifteen recognised money figures; recognition found ONE word on page 50 -- the folio -- because it is a photograph, so the page was listed nowhere and the schedule was reported as the per-issue detail nobody had read. HOW IT WAS READ: pages 48 and 50 are PHOTOGRAPHS printed sideways and were read off their OWN EMBEDDED BITMAPS at native resolution, rotated upright and magnified -- no render scale adds detail a 110 dpi scan does not hold. Page 49 carries its own text layer and was read with pdfplumber; page 51 is a 287 dpi photograph and was read from the rendered image. No recognition was used anywhere. WHAT PROVES IT, three independent ways. (1) 229 ROW IDENTITIES, principal + interest + admin fee = the issue's own printed TOTAL: all 229 close within $1.00 and most exactly. (2) THE 50 PER-ISSUE TOTALS PAGE 50 PRINTS, each against that issue's own years: every one closes within $8, and the eight largest residuals all sit on issues whose interest carries cents across up to 27 displayed years. (3) THE ISSUES RECONCILE YEAR BY YEAR TO THE GRAND TOTAL ROWS ON PAGES 49 AND 51, which were proven separately against the TOTAL column page 51 prints: in all 29 years, principal, interest, MWPAT admin fees and TOTAL DEBT each match to within $2 -- 116 assertions that no misread anywhere could survive -- with ONE exception, below. The schedule prints WHOLE DOLLARS over amounts carrying cents, so a printed total is the rounded sum and not the sum of the rounded parts; the $20.00 tolerance declared on the aggregate columns is for that and nothing else, against 229 displayed issue-years, and the measured residuals on the columns it covers are -2 on principal and +7 on admin fee. THE ONE RESIDUAL THAT IS NOT ROUNDING IS ATTESTED: in FY2019 the issues' interest exceeds the printed GRAND TOTAL INTEREST by 272, and TOTAL DEBT by the same 272, in a year where principal ties EXACTLY. 272 is precisely the FY2019 interest of MASS WATER POOL 4*, an issue whose own row closes to the dollar (10,409 + 272 = 10,681) and whose 10,409 of principal IS in the grand total. So the town's own FY2019 grand total includes that issue's principal and excludes its interest. WHICH FIGURE IS WRONG IS NOT ESTABLISHED: the issue row and the grand total row cannot both be right and nothing in the document says which. This is not a tolerance -- the aggregate interest and total columns are excluded from the column check and named here instead -- and every other year's interest is within $1. TWO GRAINS OF ONE SCHEDULE, NEVER TO BE ADDED TOGETHER: this file is the PER-ISSUE grain and `fy2018-p49-debt-schedule.csv` is the PER-YEAR grain. The Meadow Woods figures appear in both, because the schedule prints them both as issues of itself and as rows of the year summary. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: nothing here says what the town BORROWED FOR beyond the issue names it prints, and an issue name is not a project.
